notes: New material values use native projector registration, with explicit fallbacks for unregistered native channels.
Same-value indicators can belong to different machines; selections write the channel value, not a global forced block.
Chemical plant pipe selections are checked against native projector results, not assumed item ordinals. Native addTieredBlock indexes can differ from registry indicators.
The interactive web preview uses extracted native texture faces; Minecraft uses native NEI item rendering and full tooltips.
Dedicated server tests cover saved channels, cell triggers, native choices and existing terminal actions; Minecraft GUI not launched.
paging: Fixed 9-entry pages, including wheel and keyboard navigation; final page is not backfilled.
